fallback_reason: These low-resource or strongly regional languages were newly added to the selected Minecraft 1.9 primary-language scope, but a sufficiently reliable full JEI technical translation could not be guaranteed in this pass. Project policy prefers an explicit English fallback over invented or low-confidence text. The fallback can be replaced locale-by-locale after trustworthy community or expert review.
debug_policy: The three upstream DEBUG description keys remain in English for every addon locale, matching upstream's explicit 'do not need translation' comment.
technical_policy: Placeholders and technical literals must be preserved exactly, including %,d, %s, %MODNAME, ItemStack, ModId/modId syntax, mB, XP, JEI, Ctrl and Shift where applicable.
